summary: Full backend + frontend testing of BensaVahti (Finnish fuel-price predictor). 16/16 pytest tests pass (health, meta, seed idempotent, prices/history for both fuels, factors, predict/latest, regional, accuracy, prices/current via live scraping, predict/run with 4 algorithms + ensemble + LLM, invalid-fuel 400). Frontend dashboard loads correctly: hero shows 2.042 €/L national avg with 80 stations, tomorrow's ensemble prediction 1.951 €/L with all 4 method values (MA 1.940, LinReg 1.942, Holt 1.984, AI 1.928), direction pill 'halpenee -0.092 €/L', all 9 regional cities present with cells sorted cheapest first, AI explanation in Finnish ('Hinta nousee lievästi…'), AI direction badge '↑ NOUSU', Brent 109.24 USD/bbl, EUR/USD 1.1631, recharts SVG renders. Fuel toggle (95E10↔Diesel) refetches all data correctly (diesel switches to 2.167 €/L). Range toggle (30/90/365 PV) switches chart range. Refresh button triggers reloads. Run-prediction-btn re-runs LLM prediction successfully in <45s.
action_items: (Minor consistency, optional) RangeToggle emits data-testids 'range-30'/'range-90'/'range-365' while spec mentioned 'range-toggle-30' etc. The outer container correctly uses 'range-toggle'. Either rename inner testids in /app/frontend/src/components/RangeToggle.jsx line 17 to `${testIdPrefix}-toggle-${opt.value}` (matching FuelToggle convention) OR document the existing 'range-{value}' convention. Functionally works fine via text selectors.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') which is deprecated in FastAPI; consider switching to lifespan context manager.
_scrape_all swallows scraper exceptions only at outer gather; consider per-source structured logging with traceback for easier debugging.
predict.py ai_llm_predict: model 'claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929' is hard-coded; consider an env override for easier swapping.
/api/prices/current has no caching — every call hits two external scrapers (15-30s). Could benefit from a short TTL cache (e.g. 60s) to avoid burst load and improve UI responsiveness.
Frontend App.js: useEffect array dependencies disabled via eslint-disable. Refactor to memoize loaders or move state into a context — currently fine but fragile for future changes.
seed_data_creation: Database already seeded with 3600 history rows + predictions for both fuels prior to testing. /api/seed correctly returned seeded=false on idempotent call.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 16 backend pytest tests pass against the public preview URL. Tests cover health, meta, seed, prices/history (both fuels), factors, predict/latest, regional, accuracy, prices/current (live scrape), predict/run (with LLM), and validation errors. Frontend verified: refresh-prices-btn, run-prediction-btn, fuel-toggle (with -95e10/-diesel children), method-row-{moving_average|linear_regression|exp_smoothing|ai_llm}, region-cell-{Helsinki|Espoo|...|Vantaa}, ai-explanation, ai-direction, factor-brent, factor-fx, today-avg-price, today-min-price, tomorrow-prediction-card, hero-today-card all present and populated. NOTE: RangeToggle inner testids use 'range-30'/'range-90'/'range-365' pattern (not 'range-toggle-30'). LLM (Claude Sonnet 4.5) is producing real Finnish explanations — verified text 'Hinta nousee lievästi historiallisen trendin ja viikonpäivävaikutuksen perusteella…'.
